items.title: Lanny Morgan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: Med does. Med does all the writing... So Med’s got a band... and the L.A. voices too... Med will call maybe a three-hour rehearsal and we’ll go over some of these things

ctx.x: Oh this is where Med sings. Does Med sing on this?
Yeah, I don’t think I got that far. That is just I mean outrageous.
